mapper.select: select distinct u.user_id from lab_laboratory l join sys_user_role ur on 1 = 1 join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where l.id = #{laboratoryId} and l.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and r.role_key = #{roleKey} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and ( r.data_scope = '1' or (r.data_scope = '2' and exists ( select 1 from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id = r.role_id and rd.dept_id = l.dept_id )) or (r.data_scope = '3' and l.dept_id = u.dept_id) or (r.data_scope = '4' and exists ( select 1 from sys_dept scoped_dept where scoped_dept.dept_id = l.dept_id and scoped_dept.status = '0' and scoped_dept.del_flag = '0' and (scoped_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id or find_in_set(u.dept_id, scoped_dept.ancestors) > 0) )) or (r.data_scope = '5' and l.manager_id = u.user_id) ) order by u.user_id
